reader.requirement: At --std 85 the data-name of an ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause must not reference an item whose leftmost character position is that of the prime record key or of any other alternate record key of the file, including an item in another record description of the file (the keys' positions are implicitly the same character positions in every record, GR4) and a REDEFINES or the same item.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 selects Rules85 = the 2023 rows minus those a Rules1985 row Supersedes, plus Rules1985 (the 1985 SR2/SR3 key rows); 2002 selects Rules02
sortMerge1985 (SD file below 2002) skips every row; an indexed FD file is not affected

reader.notes: The 2023 row SR-12.4.5.6.3-4 is in force at 85 and compares each alternate key's record offset with the prime key's and every other alternate's, across record descriptions. The probes cover every coincidence shape; the message cites the 2023 rule and says byte for character position (the same in 1985).
